body_markdown:
NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2F&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=1&md5=c6e4513612d236593b013348d39f285f) (NYSE: EL) will hold its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders virtually on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 beginning at 9:00 a.m. (ET). Those wishing to access the webcast can visit:[www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/EL2026.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Feast.virtualshareholdermeeting.com%2Fvsm%2Fweb%3Fpvskey%3DEL2026&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com%2FEL2026.&index=2&md5=249bbcecde7226b68b76f8e8c7990549)


For further information on the meeting, The Estée Lauder Companies’[proxy statement materials](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Fen%2Finvestors%2Fearnings-and-financials%2Fproxy-statements&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=proxy+statement+materials&index=3&md5=6f536db774289ddf3372d99af8c345f6) and other information are available at[www.elcompanies.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=www.elcompanies.com%2Finvestors&index=4&md5=38cb9391b3601a637615e7b5e2ff8cb1) . Following the annual meeting, a webcast of the meeting will be available for replay on[www.elcompanies.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=www.elcompanies.com%2Finvestors&index=5&md5=ef82aec0cbad9326bd4cf0c25e896313) .


[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Fen&esheet=54638887&newsitemid=20261110429203&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=6&md5=b1ea1a12b87e84c03ecde70ed634aa6c) is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The Company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands—including The Ordinary, NIOD, Avestan and Loopha—as well as Balmain Beauty and Forest Essentials.
